text.tspan: osa-dryer: heat modules at the X2 terminals (draft 1, 2026-11-05)
Each module gets unswitched mains (X2:1 to X2:4, mains strip) and the 24 V permission HEAT_EN (X4:1, return X4:2, SELV strip), and gives back a HEAT_ON contact (X4:3, X4:4).
Every build runs this way first.
The bay holds a sheet duct from
the louvers to the riser flange.
CS1 current switch on an element lead
element current and sit in the
mains path, as the charter asks.
GAS (120 V, 15 A circuit, plus a gas line and an outdoor vent)
RLY_VALVE: relay with a 120 V coil wired across
the gas valve coil; contact closed = valve open
The burner assembly is a listed
unit with its own flame safety.
HEAT PUMP (120 V, 15 or 20 A circuit, a drain, no vent; blocked until a sealed unit is confirmed)
sealed unit: compressor with its own
CS1 current switch on the compressor lead
A full tank or a failed pump
Terminal numbers 1-2, 3-4 (contactor poles), 11-14 (relay n.o.), 11-12 (relay n.c.), 53-54 (contactor auxiliary), A1-A2 (coil) follow the IEC convention printed on the parts.
